items.title: 1.2 Introduction to Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) (Roman Urdu)

blocks.title: Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
blocks.text: Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) ek dhancha (framework) hai jo un amal ki tareef karta hai jin se idare (organizations) kisi application ko us ke ibtidai khayal (conception) se le kar deployment aur maintenance tak banate hain.

SDLC ka bunyadi maqsad aisa aala maiyar ka software dena hai jo customer ki tawaqqoaat poori kare ya un se barh jaye, waqt aur laagat (cost) ke andazon ke andar mukammal ho, aur kaarkardagi se (efficiently) kaam kare.

blocks.prompt: SDLC ka bunyadi maqsad kya hai (MCQ 1)?
blocks.explanation: Waqt aur laagat ke andazon ke andar aisa aala maiyar ka software dena jo customer ki tawaqqoaat poori kare ya un se barh jaye: option (b).

items: SDLC: application ko khayal se deployment aur maintenance tak banane ke amal ka dhancha.
Maqsad: aala maiyar ka software, waqt par, laagat ke andar, kaarkardagi se kaam karta hua.
